collections.title: Multivariable Calculus · Foundations Survey
collections.summary: Total derivatives, Hessians, constrained optimization, multiple integrals, curves and surfaces; depth routes lead through Newton methods, nonlinear fitting, KKT sensitivity, and variational weak equations.

collections.title: Local Models and Newton Methods · From Taylor Bounds to Convergence
collections.summary: Four worked studies: Taylor integral remainders and cubic error estimates; Hessian eigenvalue bounds and strong convexity; Newton corrections for systems and objectives; a proof of local quadratic convergence and safeguards.
assumed_background: Calculus of one variable, the multivariable chain rule and Hessian, eigenvalues of small symmetric matrices, and solving small linear systems.

collections.title: Nonlinear Least Squares · From Gauss–Newton to Inverse Problems
collections.summary: A four-lecture construction route: residual Jacobians and Gauss–Newton; damped steps and trust-region acceptance; singular-value identifiability and covariance; structured regularization, robust losses and statistical assumptions.
assumed_background: The multivariable chain rule and Jacobians, Taylor models and Newton corrections, linear least squares and singular values. Statistical assumptions are introduced explicitly.

collections.title: Constrained Newton and Sensitivity · From Feasible Geometry to Implicit Derivatives
collections.summary: Four constructive studies: second variation along equality constraints; active inequality cones and regularity; block Newton/KKT solves; implicit parameter derivatives, envelopes, and adjoints.
assumed_background: Jacobian and Hessian matrices; linear algebra of null spaces; Newton corrections; an introduction to Lagrange multipliers is helpful but not essential.

collections.title: Variational Methods and Weak PDEs · From First Variation to Finite Elements
collections.summary: Four construction-level studies: functional derivatives and exact energy minima; Euler–Lagrange and natural boundary terms; Sobolev weak solutions with an interface example; finite-element assembly, Galerkin orthogonality and exact error.
assumed_background: Single-variable integration by parts, elementary multivariable quadratic forms, matrix systems, and a willingness to learn the basics of weak derivatives and Hilbert spaces.
